learning_outcomes.text: Students who have successfully completed this module know the architectures and techniques used in virtual and augmented environments, as well as their algorithmic details, and can compare and differentiate them.
Students who have successfully completed this module acquire detailed knowledge in a current topic and are aware of the state of development and research.
Students can critically evaluate studies from the Mixed Reality continuum based on their current methodological expertise.
Students can develop Mixed Reality applications from conception to operation, taking into account the technical complexity of the media types discussed.
Students can conceptualize methods and procedures suitable for systematically addressing and solving selected problems from the Mixed Reality continuum within and by organizations.
Students can present their work results orally and in writing in a clearly structured form.

Students can understand and implement scientific procedures and articles from the fields of Virtual and Augmented Reality in an appropriate time. Furthermore, they can develop their own procedures based on the fundamentals from the course.

assessment_rules: Graded assessment consists of an oral examination or a written project report. The project report should be approximately 5-30 pages long, with an accompanying explanation of about 5-20 minutes. Ungraded assessment involves experimental work, consisting of approximately 4-6 experiments in total. Specifics for the oral exam are detailed in the general part of the examination regulations.
